description: What Greenlit keeps on this computer, and how old media is packed away so the disk doesn’t fill up. Archived media stays in the library: you can still see, download, restore or delete it.
archiveOnHint: Once a night, originals older than the age below are packed into one archive each.
afterHint: Counted from when the media was added.
howHint: Each file is archived on its own, so one can be restored or deleted without unpacking others.

strategy.jxlHint: About 20% smaller; the original JPEG comes back bit for bit.
strategy.flacHint: Exact samples, about half the size of WAV.
strategy.losslessHint: zstd: the same bytes back. Big savings on raw files, small on video.

missingTool: This server lacks the encoder; files fall back to an exact compressed copy.
keepPreviewsHint: They still play in the library and the editor.
skipScheduled: Never archive media of upcoming posts
skipScheduledHint: Media used by a post scheduled in the future stays as it is.
nothingOld: Nothing is old enough to archive yet.
alreadyRunning: An archive pass is already running
stoppedEarly: Stopped at its time limit; the rest follow next night.
cleanupHint: Files nothing refers to any more: leftovers from deleted media, replaced versions past their history, abandoned uploads.
keptRecent: {{count}} recent ones are kept for a day in case they’re still being used.
deleteBody: They aren’t in the library, in any version or in any post. This can’t be undone.
